questions.question: Dr. Hafssi is a member of the ONMD. According to Law 07-05, what is the status of the National Order of Dental Surgeons?
options: A public body attached to the Ministry of Health
A private law body entrusted with a public service mission
A non-profit professional association
A union defending the interests of private dentists
questions.explanation: The ONMD is a private law body entrusted with a public service mission, endowed with legal personality and governed by Law 07-05 promulgated by the Dahir of April 17, 2007.

questions.question: According to Law 07-05, are all dentists practicing in Morocco compulsory members of the ONMD?
options: No, membership in the Order is optional
Yes, the Order mandatorily brings together all dentists practicing privately
Yes, but only dentists practicing in the public sector
No, only dentists of Moroccan nationality are concerned
questions.explanation: Article 1 of Law 07-05 provides that the ONMD mandatorily brings together all dental surgeons practicing their profession privately in Morocco.

questions.question: Dr. Fadli is registered with the ONMD. According to a study on dentists' perception, which aspect of the management of the Order's register received the most satisfaction?
options: Control of the wording of professional nameplates
Review of collaboration contracts
Facilitation of registration with the Order
Organization of the continuity of care
questions.explanation: A study conducted in 2016-2017 showed that 67.5% of dentists were satisfied with the facilitation of registration with the Order, compared to only 21.9% for the control of nameplates.

questions.question: According to the same study, which aspect of the regulation exercised by the ONMD is considered insufficient by the majority of dentists?
options: Issuance of replacement authorizations
Control of the wording of professional nameplates
Examination of national diplomas
Organization of the continuity of care
questions.explanation: 48.2% of surveyed dentists declared themselves dissatisfied with the control of the wording of professional nameplates, making it the most criticized point.

questions.question: Dr. Hafssi is concerned about illegal practice. According to the ONMD, how many false dentists are practicing illegally in Morocco?
options: About 500
About 1,000
More than 3,300
More than 10,000
questions.explanation: According to the ONMD, more than 3,300 false dental surgeons practice illegally in Morocco, daily endangering the lives of citizens.

questions.question: Dr. Fadli is alerted by the practices of certain 'denture makers.' According to the ONMD, what is the main problem?
options: They manufacture poor quality prostheses
They receive patients for pseudo-medical treatments outside their authorization
They sell prostheses that are too expensive
They do not declare their tax income
questions.explanation: The ONMD alerts about 'denture makers' who receive patients for pseudo-medical treatments carried out in flagrant illegality, outside the framework of their authorization which is limited to manufacturing on prescription.

questions.question: According to the ONMD, what are the consequences of illegal practices in dental medicine?
options: Only insufficient quality of care
Deaths, permanent disabilities, and infectious diseases
Higher costs for patients
Simple unfair competition for legal dentists
questions.explanation: The ONMD denounces dramatic incidents: deaths due to the use of falsified or expired anesthetic products, random overdoses, permanent disabilities, or infectious diseases contracted in deplorable hygiene conditions.

questions.question: Dr. Hafssi is wondering about the draft law 25-14. According to the ONMD, what is the main objective of this text?
options: Increase the fees for dental procedures
Protect legal and regulated practice and fight against usurpers
Create new dental medicine faculties
Modify the conditions of registration with the Order
questions.explanation: The draft law n°25-14 aims to protect the legal and regulated practice of the professions of preparers and handlers of health products, including dental prosthetists, to remove usurpers.

questions.question: According to the ONMD, why are dentistry charlatans leading a campaign against draft law 25-14?
options: To obtain better remuneration
To create confusion and attempt to amend the text
To protest against working conditions
To demand academic training
questions.explanation: The ONMD denounces a disinformation campaign by charlatans, aimed at creating confusion among citizens and parliamentarians to attempt to amend the draft law.

questions.question: Dr. Fadli learned that several regions of Morocco face a shortage of dentists. What solution has been implemented to remedy this?
options: Recruitment of foreign dentists only
Contracting of private sector dentists via Decree 2.12.507
Closure of practices in rural areas
Increase in consultation fees
questions.explanation: Decree No. 2.12.507 allows the Ministry of Health to use private sector dentists to work part-time in public hospitals, notably for the continuity of care.

questions.question: According to Decree 2.12.507, what is the monthly remuneration cap for a contracted dentist?
questions.explanation: Decree 2.12.507 sets the maximum monthly gross remuneration at 7,143 DH, payable upon maturity within the limit of 11 months per year.

questions.question: Dr. Hafssi wishes to be contracted. According to Article 6 of Decree 2.12.507, what are the eligibility conditions?
options: Be under 30 years old
Be registered with the Order and not have been subject to disciplinary sanctions
Practice exclusively in rural areas
Have more than 10 years of experience
questions.explanation: Article 6 of Decree 2.12.507 stipulates that candidates must be registered with the professional order, not have been subject to an ordinal disciplinary sanction, and not have been convicted of crimes against persons or offenses against public morality.

questions.question: According to Decree 2.12.507, what is the maximum duration of a standard agreement?
options: 6 months
11 months, renewable tacitly 3 times
2 years
5 years
questions.explanation: In accordance with Article 5 of Decree 2.12.507, the agreement is concluded for a maximum duration of eleven months, renewable tacitly three times at most.

questions.question: Dr. Fadli is contracted and practices at the hospital. According to Decree 2.12.507, to which authority is he subject?
options: Only to the National Order of Dental Surgeons
To the authority of the hierarchical head of the public health establishment
To no authority, he is independent
To the Ministry of Commerce
questions.explanation: Article 9 of Decree 2.12.507 specifies that the contracted dentist is subject to the authority of the hierarchical head of the health establishment.

questions.question: According to Decree 2.12.507, what are the obligations of a contracted dentist regarding responsibility?
options: They are not responsible for their actions
They direct and supervise the work of interns placed under their authority
Responsibility lies solely with the hospital
They are exempt from any responsibility
questions.explanation: Article 9 of Decree 2.12.507 provides that contracted dentists direct and supervise the work of interns and staff placed directly under their authority.

questions.question: According to the ONMD, what is the impact of illegal practice on Morocco's international reputation?
options: No impact, the phenomenon is marginal
Some foreign embassies have issued alerts to their nationals
Morocco is praised for its fight against this phenomenon
Tourists are attracted by low prices
questions.explanation: Some foreign embassies have issued official alerts to their nationals, warning them of the risks related to care received in unapproved establishments in Morocco.

questions.question: Dr. Hafssi is interested in the fight against illegal practice. What types of premises are particularly targeted by the ONMD?
options: Dental practices in rural areas
Establishments known as 'denture makers'
Contracted private dental clinics
Dental departments of public hospitals
questions.explanation: The ONMD alerts about premises known as 'denture makers' where citizens are received for pseudo-medical treatments carried out in flagrant illegality.

questions.question: According to demographic data, what is the disparity in the distribution of dentists in the public sector in Morocco?
options: It is perfectly balanced
It varies from 1 dentist for 12,631 to 1 for 728,634 inhabitants depending on the region
All regions have a similar ratio
Rural areas are better served than urban areas
questions.explanation: The proportion of public dentists varies considerably, ranging from 1 dentist for 12,631 inhabitants in some regions to 1 dentist for 728,634 inhabitants in others.

questions.question: According to the ONMD, what is the impact of illegal practices on public health?
options: A minimal risk for patients
A direct threat to citizens' health and the security of the national health system
A simple problem of economic competition
An exclusively ethical issue
questions.explanation: The ONMD considers these practices as a 'direct threat to citizens' health and the security of the national health system,' calling for urgent action.

questions.question: According to the ONMD, what is the role of dental prosthetists within the legal framework?
options: They can receive patients for consultations
Their authorization is limited to the manufacture of prostheses on prescription from the dentist
They can perform medical acts in their laboratory
They are authorized to place dental implants
questions.explanation: The ONMD reminds that the authorization of dental prosthetists is limited to the manufacture of prostheses on prescription from the dental surgeon, without patient reception or performance of medical acts.

questions.question: Dr. Fadli wants to know the opinion of the FDI on illegal practice in Morocco. What is its position?
options: It supports the charlatans in their approach
It has expressed its indignation and supports the ONMD's action
It is neutral on the issue
It has not spoken out
questions.explanation: The FDI, which brings together 900,000 dental doctors in 137 countries, expressed its 'indignation' in a letter to the president of the ONMD, supporting the fight against illegal practice.

questions.question: According to a study on dentists' perception, what percentage of them consider it necessary to establish permanent control commissions?
questions.explanation: The study showed that 76.3% of dentists surveyed considered it necessary to establish permanent control commissions to fight against illegal practices.

questions.question: According to Law 07-05, what are the main missions of the ONMD?
options: Only the management of the Order's register
Regulation, complaint management, fight against illegal practice, continuing education, and public-private partnership
Setting the fees for dental procedures
Management of dental mutual insurance companies
questions.explanation: The missions of the ONMD described in Article 13 of Law 07-05 cover register management, regulation, complaints, fight against illegal practice, continuing education, public-private partnership, and social welfare.

questions.question: Dr. Hafssi is wondering about Morocco's role in dental health in Africa. What is the Kingdom's ambition according to the ONMD?
options: Become a reference medical center in Africa
Be content with training dentists for the local market
Reduce the number of dental medicine faculties
Limit access to dental care
questions.explanation: The ONMD emphasizes that Morocco aspires to become a reference medical center in Africa, which requires fighting against illegal practices that harm this image.

questions.question: According to Decree 2.12.507, what can lead to the termination of the agreement of a contracted dentist?
options: A simple request from the dentist without notice
An absence during three work sessions without valid reason
A disagreement with working hours
A request from the ministry at any time
questions.explanation: Article 10 of Decree 2.12.507 provides that any absence during three work sessions, without prior information and without valid reason, is a cause for termination of the agreement by the administration without notice.

questions.question: According to the ONMD, what is the link between major international events and the fight against illegal practice?
options: No link, events are not concerned
Morocco is preparing to welcome tourists, which requires enhanced health vigilance
Events only attract legal dentists
Illegal practice is only a local problem
questions.explanation: The ONMD emphasizes that Morocco is preparing to host major international tourist and sporting events, making enhanced vigilance essential to guarantee health safety standards.
